EV-1.question: Does the before/after difference between quiet hand-free frames isolate the removed or moved part, without a model?
EV-1.quiet_frame: motion <= 25th percentile AND skin <= 25th percentile of that video
EV-1.pair: consecutive quiet frames with >= 1 non-quiet sample between them
EV-1.change: Lab: deltaE76 > 14; a pixel counts as shadow (ignored) if |delta a|,|delta b| <= 4 and L ratio in [0.45, 0.92]
EV-1.cleanup: open 5 px, close 9 px, holes filled, components >= 300 mm2
EV-1.binding_candidates: custody site_changed events whose [t_before_s, t_after_s] overlaps the pair interval (candidates only)
EV-1.report: every pair with change; visual check: does the largest component outline the part that left or arrived?

MF-1.question: Can outline pieces visible in different held frames be fused into one complete outline?
MF-1.frames: 6 from frames.select (skin is NOT penalised away: hands are expected)
MF-1.per_frame_mask: frozen r4.1 Muse box -> SAM on each rectified frame (part phrase: back shell of the game controller)
MF-1.skin: quality.skin_fraction rule; mask pixels within 6 px of skin are 'occluded'
MF-1.alignment: ECC affine on mask distance maps to the frame with the least skin; residual IoU reported
MF-1.fusion: outline pixels kept only where not occluded in at least one aligned frame; union of aligned masks; fused outline per source frame
MF-1.report: fused outline over the reference frame, per-frame contributions, alignment residuals; held parts tilt and move closer to the camera, so a non-rigid residual is expected and reported, not hidden
